label: Instance costs
description: Read what one instance's runs cost: every call that booked a price, each saying whose credential paid (the runtime's credit, your own connection, or the instance's own), plus the total. Narrow by service, node, who paid, or a start time. Weft reports what it measured; what you bill for it is your program's to decide.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance, by the id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: Only the costs this node booked, named the way the program writes it.

inputs.name: paidBy
inputs.description: Only the costs paid from this kind of credential: `platform` (the runtime's credit), `author` (your own connection) or `instance` (the instance's own).

inputs.name: since
inputs.description: Only the costs booked at or after this moment, in unix seconds.

outputs.name: records
outputs.description: One entry per priced call: `{ run, instance, node, service, model?, amount_usd, paid_by, at_unix }`. `amount_usd` is null when the service's price could not be measured.

outputs.name: totalUsd
outputs.description: The sum of every measured `amount_usd`, in US dollars.

then.message: InstanceCosts '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no node of this program. Name it the way the program writes it (`draft`, or `one.draft` inside an included file).
